scope: Legacy prebuilt Camera interface; native live and native VIN recorder capabilities below. No hardware probe.

exposure.reason: Camera::SetExposure ignores value and only returns whether device pointer exists; verified bundled x5/s100/x86_64 ELF

aps_fps.reason: SetFrameRate/GetFrameRate are EVS-only per API.md; 30 fps sensor profile/AVI header is not readback

native_raw8.reason: No pixel format selector. VIN bypass returns software-derived Bayer8 (RAW10 >> 2), not native APS RAW8

hardware_ae_awb.reason: Internal X5 ISP 2A exists but is not publicly configurable/readable; bypass skips it

software_ae.reason: No effective exposure setter or frame exposure feedback

software_wb.scope: Explicit preserved Bayer input only; never applied to hardware NV12

metadata.reason: Public Frame has format, geometry and timestamp pairing, but no these fields; reject padded buffers

formats.raw_save: unchanged derived Bayer8 samples; not original RAW10
formats.display: 8-bit BGR gamma encoded; identity CCM, uncalibrated

native_vin_record.storage: bounded preallocated process arena, both raw DMA planes; save only after camera stops
native_vin_record.exposure_us: requires independently verified --aps-line-time-us, rounds to nearest line; no nominal-fps inference
native_vin_record.gain_db: 0..24 analog, nearest 0.375 dB using supplied guide's 65-entry analog table; digital unity
native_vin_record.ownership: explicit verified I2C bus, configured 7-bit address, chip ID check, non-forced I2C_SLAVE, no ISP created
native_vin_record.readback: register snapshot after set, periodically and before stop; SDK exposure getter unavailable; not per-frame actual exposure
native_vin_record.raw_layout: full original planes plus stride; APS profile RAW10 16-bit words, preview uses SDK-audited word >> 2
native_vin_record.performance: independent VIN consumers, no dispatch latest-frame slot; VIN IDs and full-window rates measured, sensor output/loss upstream unknown
native_vin_record.verified: host C++ fake backend and CLI tests; production SDK build, X5 30 FPS and optical response pending

native_live.gain_request: positive SDK float values; encoding and sensor limits unverified (not a register/dB interface)
native_live.configuration: after both vflows start; get/set/get errors fatal; configuration snapshot saved; actual sensor values unknown
native_live.range: sensor limits unavailable locally; positive finite requests delegated to matching SDK
native_live.ae_auto: disabled for this HVS sensor_mode=2 profile per official sample nonconvergence
native_live.awb: ISP manual neutral gains; existing application residual WB optional for NV12
native_live.verified: Windows simulated backend only; X5 SDK compile and physical exposure effect pending
